text: Each row comes from real matches in a league whose organiser switched the deciders on: Ana beats Ben in regulation and again after each way the league can settle a match beyond regulation.
Football: Ana beat Ben after extra time, 1 — 0.
Football: Ana beat Ben after penalty shoot-out, 2 — 2 (5–4 pens).
Cricket: Ana beat Ben after super over, 113/9 (20) — 113/7 (20) · SO 10–8.
Ice hockey (IIHF): Ana beat Ben after overtime, 1 — 0 (OT).
Ice hockey (IIHF): Ana beat Ben after shoot-out, 2 — 1 (GWS 5–4).
Ice hockey (Recreational): Ana beat Ben after overtime, 1 — 0 (OT).
Ice hockey (Recreational): Ana beat Ben after shoot-out, 2 — 1 (GWS 5–4).
Hockey: Ana beat Ben after shoot-out, 1 — 1 (SO 4–1).
